besluite.fout: 'Sy plek tel ook' is vague on its own: a reader cannot tell at once that the grasshopper's position in the picture is meant.
besluite.rede: Adding 'in die prent' makes clear it is about placement in the picture, adds no fact, and leaves the size-and-line sense unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'daardie' reads stiffly for jaws named in the sentence before, and 'na daardie kake wat na bo buig' doubles 'na' clumsily.
besluite.rede: 'na die kake wat boontoe buig' is the natural Afrikaans; 'boontoe' and 'na bo' mean the same direction, so the meaning holds and no protected wording is touched.
